description: This file contains functions and types related to configuring web search providers within the OpenClaw project, including setup flows, provider resolution, credential handling, and user prompts.

methods.name: resolveSearchProviderCredentialLabel
methods.description: Generates a label for the search provider credential, indicating whether setup or API key is required.

methods.name: resolveSearchProviderOptions
methods.description: Returns available search provider options based on current configuration.

methods.name: showsSearchProviderInSetup
methods.description: Determines if a search provider should be shown in setup based on onboarding scopes.

methods.name: canRepairBundledProviderSelection
methods.description: Checks if a bundled provider can be repaired or re-selected based on plugin and config state.

methods.name: resolveSearchProviderSetupContributions
methods.description: Builds a list of setup contributions for search providers, merging bundled and runtime providers.

methods.name: resolveSearchProviderEntry
methods.description: Finds the plugin entry for a given search provider.

methods.name: hasKeyInEnv
methods.description: Checks if environment variables for a provider are set.

methods.name: providerNeedsCredential
methods.description: Determines if a provider requires a credential.

methods.name: providerIsReady
methods.description: Checks if a provider is ready to use based on config and environment.

methods.name: rawKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the raw credential value for a provider from config.

methods.name: resolveExistingKey
methods.description: Normalizes and returns the existing credential key for a provider.

methods.name: hasExistingKey
methods.description: Checks if a valid credential key exists for a provider.

methods.name: buildSearchEnvRef
methods.description: Builds a secret reference object for environment variable credentials.

methods.name: resolveSearchSecretInput
methods.description: Resolves the secret input mode (ref or direct) for a provider.

methods.name: applySearchKey
methods.description: Applies a credential key to the configuration for a provider.

methods.name: applySearchProviderSelection
methods.description: Sets the selected search provider in the configuration.

methods.name: applySearchProviderSelectionConfig
methods.description: Applies plugin-specific selection configuration.

methods.name: preserveDisabledState
methods.description: Preserves the disabled state of the search provider in the config.

methods.name: finalizeSearchProviderSetup
methods.description: Finalizes setup by running provider-specific setup routines.

methods.name: runSearchSetupFlow
methods.description: Runs the interactive setup flow for selecting and configuring a web search provider.
